name: claude-seo
description: SEO and GEO audit plugin for Claude Code, OpenCode and Codex. Agy-SEO fork maintained by Mostafa Daoud, based on Claude SEO by Agrici Daniel. 26 sub-skills (22 core + 1 orchestrator + 1 framework + 2 extension mirrors) and 19 sub-agents cover technical SEO, content, schema, sitemaps, Core Web Vitals, local, backlinks, AI search, ecommerce, hreflang, SXO, clustering, drift and Google APIs. Includes MCP extensions and SPA rendering.
